blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面评价基准量化所取出的证据是否涵盖满足信息需要所需的不同信息。 现有基准大多考虑可能已经知道是预先训练的检索组件的事实性索赔,对于检索者是否发现与这些前科相矛盾的物证,则留有余地。 我们研究寻回者如何行为 当他们的参数化知识和一个实体中的信息不一致。 为此,我们发展了一个进程,以控制矛盾的方式扩大基于小块的覆盖基准。 对于每一个小项,我们都会创建一个否定的对应方,并编辑其辅助文件,以支持这种否定,同时保留上下文. 将这一过程应用于“覆盖本奇”这个衡量信息覆盖度的基准,我们创建了“覆盖本奇-内盖特”系统,涵盖六个数据集和大约63 000个原始编辑的证据对(每个小块文件链接一个)。 我们把丰富的构造元数据 附加到每对, 并额外提供家庭外 LLM 判断 在所有对对对 和人审计一个样本。 在基线实验中,BM25将原始证据和被编辑的近胜证据区分开来,大大优于密集取回器(Qune3和Jina),它们保持了接近的机会. 我们发布Hugging Face Datas集(nuggets,文档,对等)的基准以及建筑材料,包括用于创建的提示.

blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely heavily on the information they retrieve. If the retrieved documents repeat the same point or leave out an important claim, the final answer can be incomplete even when every document is relevant. Retrieval quality, thus, depends not only on finding relevant documents, but on finding a complete set of distinct evidence to support an answer.
blocks.zh: 检索到的生成(RAG)系统严重依赖它们检索到的信息. 如果检索到的文件重复同一点,或遗漏一个重要主张,即使每份文件都相关,最后的答案也可能不完整. 因此,检索质量不仅取决于找到相关文件,而且取决于找到一整套支持答复的明显证据。

blocks.en:
Rather than focusing on whether each retrieved document is relevant, coverage evaluation asks whether the retrieved set contains the information needed to answer a query. This information is often represented as nuggets : small, atomic claims that a complete answer should cover ( Pradeep et al., 2024b ; Łajewska and Balog, 2025 ) . Existing coverage benchmarks typically evaluate ordinary historical or world facts that commonly appear in the data used to train language models.
Meanwhile, modern retrieval pipelines increasingly build on those same language models.
Many dense retrievers, neural rerankers, and LLM-based query expansion methods inherit, directly or indirectly, the world knowledge absorbed during pretraining. Consequently, they may favor the more familiar version of a claim over the evidence that is actually present in the corpus ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) . This raises the question: when the corpus supports a claim that conflicts with what these language models have seen during pretraining, will the retrieval system still surface that evidence?
blocks.zh:
覆盖面评价没有侧重于每个检索到的文件是否相关,而是询问检索到的整套文件是否包含回答询问所需的信息。 这一信息往往被表述为:小的,原子的声称,一个完整的答案应该涵盖(Pradeep等人,2024b; ajewska and Balog,2025). 现有覆盖基准通常评价用于培训语言模型的数据中常见的普通历史或世界事实。
与此同时,现代检索管道越来越多地利用这些语言模式。
许多密集的检索器,神经重排器,以及基于LLM的查询扩展方法直接或间接地继承了在预训中吸收的世界知识. 因此,他们可能倾向于采用更熟悉的说法,而不是实际存在于诉讼文书中的证据(Sahoo等人,2026年)。 这就提出了这样一个问题:当委托书支持一种说法,即与这些语言模型在预训期间所看到的相冲突时,检索系统是否会仍然浮出证据?

blocks.en: To study this, we develop a general process for augmenting a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. The process keeps the original topics fixed, and for each nugget, it constructs a negated counterpart. Then, it edits the supporting documents so they support the negation while preserving the surrounding context. Since the topics, entities, and contexts stay fixed, this paired design isolates the polarity flip from confounds such as topic or entity shift. Applying it to CoverageBench ( Samuel et al., 2026b ) , we create CoverageBench-Negate. It covers six datasets: 284 topics and roughly 63,000 edited document pairs, spanning every topic and 2,975 nuggets. Each evidence pair is released with quality metadata so researchers can apply strict or permissive filters depending on the diagnostic setting.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这一点,我们制订了一个总的进程,以扩大一个以小块为基础的、有控制矛盾的覆盖基准。 这一过程保持了原始主题的固定,对于每一个小项,它会构建一个否定的对应物. 然后,它编辑辅助文档,以便它们支持否定,同时保留周围上下文。 由于主题,实体,和上下文保持不变,这种配对设计将极性翻转从诸如主题或实体转移等混乱中分离出来. 将它应用到Speed Bench(Samuel等人,2026b)中,我们创建了Speed Bench-Negate. 它包括6个数据集:284个专题和大约63 000个经过编辑的文件对,涉及每个专题和2 975块。 每个证据配对都会随质量元数据而发布,这样研究人员可以根据诊断环境应用严格的或允许的过滤器.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) We develop a reusable process for augmenting nugget-based coverage benchmarks with controlled contradictions to test whether retrievers stay faithful to corpus evidence, and use it to create CoverageBench-Negate; (2) We release the full benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (negated nuggets, edited supporting documents, a paired evidence set, quality metadata, and our human and LLM-based validations), making it auditable and reusable; and (3) We provide a baseline characterization over retriever-visible top-1000 subsets, showing that BM25 distinguishes original from edited near-twin evidence better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: (1) 我们开发一个可重复使用的程序,以扩大基于微量元素的覆盖基准,并有可控的矛盾,以测试检索者是否忠实于实体证据,并使用它来创建覆盖本赫-内盖特;(2) 我们公布Hugging Face Datas集(负面的微量元素,经编辑的辅助文件,一对证据集,质量元数据,以及我们基于人类和LLM的验证)的完整基准,使其可以审计和重复使用;(3) 我们提供了对于可观察到的BM25子集的基线描述,表明BM25与经编辑的近赢证据的区别优于密集检索器(Quen3和Jina)。

blocks.en: 2. Background
blocks.zh: 2. 背景情况

blocks.en: Information coverage evaluates a retrieved set of documents by how many distinct pieces of information (aspects) it covers. This underlies recent nugget-based evaluations, where answers are scored for completeness and grounding against nuggets: ARGUE for machine-generated reports ( Mayfield et al., 2024 ) , the AutoNuggetizer framework for TREC RAG ( Pradeep et al., 2024b ) , the Ragnarök RAG evaluation framework ( Pradeep et al., 2024a ) , and nugget-grounded generation pipelines such as GINGER ( Łajewska and Balog, 2025 ) . CoverageBench ( Samuel et al., 2026b ) provides a reusable resource for evaluating retrieval by standardizing topics, nuggets, nugget-level relevance labels, document collections, and baseline rankings across multiple retrieval settings. Crucially for a retrieval-focused benchmark, retrieval-side coverage metrics were shown to correlate strongly with the information coverage of downstream RAG responses ( Samuel et al., 2026a ) , so evaluating coverage at the retrieval stage is a meaningful proxy for end-to-end RAG behavior.
blocks.zh: 信息覆盖通过它涵盖多少不同的信息(方面)来评价一套检索到的文件。 这一点是最近基于新币的评价的基础,其中的答案是完整的和以新币为基础的:机器生成报告的ARGUE(Mayfield等人,2024年),TREC RAG的自动增殖剂框架(Pradeep等人,2024年b),Ragnarrök RAG评价框架(Pradeep等人,2024年a),以及诸如GINGER(QQajewska和Balog,2025年)等基于新币的发电管道。 Information Bench(Samuel等人,2026年b)为评价检索提供了一个可重复使用的资源,办法是将专题、元件、元件级相关标签、文件收藏以及跨多个检索设置的基准排名标准化。 至关重要的是,对于注重检索的基准而言,检索的侧面覆盖度衡量标准与下游RAG反应的信息覆盖度密切相关(Samuel等人,2026a),因此,评价检索阶段的覆盖度是对终端至终端RAG行为的有意义的替代。

blocks.en: A related line of work probes whether RAG systems follow the corpus or fall back on parametric knowledge. Closest to our setting, CRUMQs augments RAG evaluation with unanswerable multi-hop queries, testing whether systems invoke parametric knowledge when the required evidence is absent ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Building on the CoverageBench structure, CoverageBench-Negate poses a complementary question of whether systems still cover corpus-supported claims when those claims conflict with parametric knowledge. CRUMQs probes reliance on outside knowledge by removing support, while we probe it by adding contradicting, corpus-supported evidence.
blocks.zh: 一个相关的工作领域是探查RAG系统是跟随本体还是回到参数化知识上. CRUMQs最接近我们的设置,用无法回答的多跳查询来增强RAG评价,测试系统是否在缺少所需证据时引用参数知识(Liu等人,2025年). 在 " 覆盖奔驰 " 结构的基础上, " 覆盖奔驰-内盖特 " 系统提出了一个补充问题,即当这些索赔与参数知识相冲突时,这些系统是否仍然涵盖由实体支持的索赔。 CRUMQs通过去除支持来探究对外界知识的依赖,而我们通过增加矛盾的,命案支持的证据来探究.

blocks.en: Work on factual evaluation states that atomic claims must be explicitly supported, not merely topically related ( Min et al., 2023 ; Thorne et al., 2018 ) . Yet dense retrievers, rerankers, and LLM-based query expansion tend to reward semantic similarity, fluent reformulation, and learned associations, and can be brittle under subtle, adversarially constructed perturbations ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于事实评估的工作指出,必须明确支持原子权利主张,而不仅仅是与主题有关(Min等人,2023年;Torne等人,2018年)。 然而密集的检索者、重新排名者和基于LLM的查询扩展往往会奖励语义相似性、流利的重塑和有学识的协会,并且可以在微妙的、对抗性地构造的扰动下变得脆弱(Liu等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Negation is a particularly hard case. Recent analysis shows that dense retrievers may treat two passages as similar because they share a topic even when one states “X” and the other “not X” ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) . Negation-sensitive ranking benchmarks such as NevIR find that retrievers struggle to separate a claim from its negation ( Weller et al., [n. d.] ; Van Den Elsen et al., 2025 ; Petcu et al., 2025 ) . In a corpus-grounded setting, however, the desired behavior is not to retrieve what is globally likely but what the corpus actually supports ( Kebir et al., 2026 ) . Testing this cleanly requires paired evidence in which the context stays fixed while only the supported claim changes.
blocks.zh: 否认尤其困难。 最近的分析表明,密集的检索器可能把两个段落当作相似之处,因为即使一个段落说“X”,另一个段落说“不是X”(Sahoo等人,2026年)。 NevIR等对忽略敏感的排名基准发现,检索者试图将索赔与其否定区分开来(Wiler等人,[n.d.];Van Den. Elsen等人,2025年;Petcu等人,2025年). 然而,在基于生物体的环境下,理想的行为不是要收回全球可能的东西,而是要收回生物体实际支持的东西(Kebir等人,2026年)。 检验这种清洁要求有对齐的证据,在这种证据中,上下文保持不变,而只有支持的索赔更改。

blocks.en: Negation offers a practical way to construct such pairs, flipping the supported claim while leaving the topic, entities, and much of the document intact. Prior work shows that models struggle when negation changes entailment in controlled NLI settings ( Geiger et al., 2020 ; Truong et al., 2022 ; She et al., 2023 ) , precisely the meaning-changing edit we exploit. This mirrors contrast sets, where small label-changing edits test whether a model responds to the changed meaning rather than surface form ( Gardner et al., 2020 ) . We use negation as a controlled augmentation rather than a target in itself: each original nugget and supporting document is paired with a negated nugget and an edited document, with construction details in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 否定提供了一种实际的方法来构建这种对称,在使专题、实体和大部分文件完好无损的情况下翻转支持的主张。 先前的研究表明,模型在否定受控制的NLI环境中的变化时会挣扎(Geiger等人,2020年;Truong等人,2022年;She等人,2023年),正是我们利用的改变意义的编辑。 这个镜像反射集,其中小的改变标签编辑测试一个模型是否响应了改变的意义而不是表面形态(Gardner等人,2020年). 我们把否定作为控制下的增强而不是目标本身:每个原始的元件和辅助文件都配有否定的元件和经过编辑的文件,第3节有构建细节。

blocks.en: 3. Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3个 基准建设

blocks.en: CoverageBench-Negate 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/pashaa/CoverageBench-Negate . applies a reusable, negation-based augmentation process to six CoverageBench ( Samuel et al., 2026b ) datasets: CAsT 2020 ( Dalton et al., 2021 ) , NeuCLIR 2024 ( Lawrie et al., 2025 ) , RAG 2024 ( Pradeep et al., 2024b ) , CRUX-DUC04 ( Ju et al., 2026 ) , CRUX-MultiNews ( Ju et al., 2026 ) , and RAGTIME 2025 ( Lawrie et al., 2026 ) . We omit Fair Ranking 2022 ( Ekstrand et al., 2023 ) because its nuggets are fairness facets rather than factual claims. During augmentation, we keep the original topics, nuggets, and documents unchanged and add a paired negation layer on top.
blocks.zh: Bench-Negate 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/pashaa/Coverage Bench-Negate 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. . 对六个覆盖本赫(Samuel等人,2026b)数据集适用可重复使用的否定式增强程序:CAsT 2020(Dalton等人,2021年),NeuCLIR 2024(Lawrie等人,2025年),RAG 2024(Pradeep等人,2024b年),CRUX-DUC04(Ju等人,2026年),CRUX-MultiNews(Ju等人,2026年),以及RAGTIME 2025(Lawrie等人,2026年)。 我们省略了Fair Ranking 2022(Ekstrand等人,2023年),因为它的缺陷是公平方面,而不是事实主张。 在扩增期间,我们保持原有话题,元件,文档不变,并在顶部添加一对否定层.

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates the pipeline. We generate and validate one negated nugget per original nugget, and then edit and validate a supporting document for each surviving link. 2 2 2 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct performs nugget negation, span localization, document rewriting, and all LLM-based judgments (sampling T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 , top- p = 0.9 p{=}0.9 , up to 8,192 generated tokens); Qwen3-Embedding-8B performs all embedding-based checks. Since the same model both produces and judges these artifacts, we additionally validate the released pairs with an independent, out-of-family judge and a human audit. The resource consists of the following components:
blocks.zh: 图1说明了管道情况。 我们生成和验证每个原始元件一个否定的元件,然后编辑和验证每个幸存链接的辅助文档。 2 2 2 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 执行否定元件,横跨本地化,文件重写,以及所有基于 LLM 的判断(样本 T = 0.7 T = 0.7,顶端-p = 0.9 p = 0.9 p 0.9,最多8 192 生成的令牌); Quen3-Embedding-8B 执行所有嵌入式检查 。 由于同样的模型 生产 和判断这些文物, 我们额外验证 释放的对夫妇 与独立, 家庭外法官和人的审计。 资源包括下列部分:

blocks.en:
• Topics, original nuggets, and links. We reuse all 284 CoverageBench topics without modification, and retain the 3,496 nuggets and 116,842 nugget–document support links. A link is a tuple ( t , n , d ) (t,n,d) : document d d supports nugget n n under topic t t , and 3,234 nuggets have at least one supporting document. Keeping the originals lets the benchmark continue to measure ordinary information coverage alongside the negated coverage. • Negated nuggets. For every nugget n n , we create one negated nugget n ¯ \bar{n} that contradicts the original claim while preserving the topic scope, entities, and event context (Section 3.1 ). • Edited documents. For each support link, we attempt to create an edited document d ¯ \bar{d} that supports n ¯ \bar{n} instead of n n , changing only the target claim while keeping the context intact. Editing is per link rather than per unique document since one source document can support several nuggets. After pre-filtering and failed edits, the 116,842 links yield 63,372 edited documents (Section 3.2 ). • Paired evidence set. The main artifact is a link-level paired evidence set of 63,372 pairs spanning every topic, and 2,975 original nuggets. Each pair connects an original topic, nugget, and supporting document with a negated nugget, edited document, and construction metadata. • Metadata. At every stage of the pipeline, we record diagnostics (edit-size and embedding-similarity measurements), validation outcomes
, and categorical labels (negation type), so that users can filter the benchmark to their needs. Some checks determine what enters the benchmark; the rest are labels users can filter on (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
• 专题、原始物品和链接。 保留3,496块和116,842块文件支持链接。 链接为tuple(t,n,d) (t,n,d) : dd 文档支持主题 t t 下的 n, 3, 234 个 nuggets至少有一个辅助文档 。 保留原始内容使基准能够继续衡量普通信息覆盖面和被否定的覆盖面。 • 被忽略的宝石。 对于每个元件 n, 我们创建一个否定的元件 n'\ bar{n} , 与原来的主张相矛盾, 同时保留主题范围、 实体和事件背景( 第3.1节) 。 • 编辑文件。 对于每个支持链接,我们尝试创建一个支持 n\bar{n} 而不是 n n的编辑文档 d\ bar{d}, 只更改目标要求, 同时保持上下文完整 。 编辑是每个链接,而不是每个独特的文档,因为一个源文档可以支持几个小块. 经过预过滤和失败编辑后,116 842链接产生63 372个经编辑的文件(第3.2节)。 • 成套证据。 主要文物是连线级配对证据集,共63,372对,跨越每个题材,以及2,975个原始小块. 每对连接一个原始主题,元件,以及辅助文档与否定的元件,已编辑文档和构造元数据. • 元数据。 在管道的每个阶段,我们记录诊断(编辑大小和嵌入-同质性测量),验证结果
,和断然标签(负数类型),这样用户就可以根据自己的需要过滤基准。 一些检查决定了进入基准的是什么;其余是标签用户可以过滤(第3.3节)。

blocks.zh: 已编辑文档 。 对于每个支持链接,我们尝试创建一个支持 n\bar{n} 而不是 n n的编辑文档 d\ bar{d}, 只更改目标要求, 同时保持上下文完整 。 编辑是每个链接,而不是每个独特的文档,因为一个源文档可以支持几个小块. 经过预过滤和失败编辑后,116 842链接产生63 372个经编辑的文件(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Paired evidence set. The main artifact is a link-level paired evidence set of 63,372 pairs spanning every topic, and 2,975 original nuggets. Each pair connects an original topic, nugget, and supporting document with a negated nugget, edited document, and construction metadata.
blocks.zh: 帕耶证据组. 主要文物是连线级配对证据集,共63,372对,跨越每个题材,以及2,975个原始小块. 每对连接一个原始主题,元件,以及辅助文档与否定的元件,已编辑文档和构造元数据.

blocks.en:
Metadata. At every stage of the pipeline, we record diagnostics (edit-size and embedding-similarity measurements), validation outcomes
, and categorical labels (negation type), so that users can filter the benchmark to their needs. Some checks determine what enters the benchmark; the rest are labels users can filter on (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
元数据。 在管道的每个阶段,我们记录诊断(编辑大小和嵌入-同质性测量),验证结果
,和断然标签(负数类型),这样用户就可以根据自己的需要过滤基准。 一些检查决定了进入基准的是什么;其余是标签用户可以过滤(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1. Negated Nugget Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1. 被忽视的营养物质建设

blocks.en:
For each nugget, we prompt the LLM to write a negated version such that the original and the negation cannot both be true. Two LLM checks then refine the result. A single validation call scores three criteria: whether the negation reverses the original meaning, reads naturally as a standalone claim, and preserves the relevant entities. A separate mutual-exclusivity call asks whether the original and negated nuggets could both be true, regenerating the negation from the failed attempt up to three times.
Separately, an embedding check labels each negation by whether it stays on-topic yet meaningfully different from the original and whether it collides with another gold nugget in the same topic. These checks label quality rather than filter, and no nugget is removed at this stage.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个元件,我们促使 LLM 写一个否定的版本,这样原本和否定都不可能是真实的. 两次LLM检查之后对结果进行了细化. 单项验证调用得分分为三个标准:否定是否颠倒原意,自然读作独立主张,并保留相关实体. 一个单独的相互排斥的呼声询问原始的和否定的元件是否都是真的,从失败的尝试中重新产生否定,最多三次.
另外,一个嵌入式检查标签会通过它是否停留在主题上,但与原始内容有有意义的区别,以及它是否与同一主题的另一个金块相撞来否定每个标记。 这些检查标签质量而非过滤,在此阶段不会移除任何小块.

blocks.en: 3.2. Edited Document Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2. 编辑的文件建设

blocks.en:
Editing operates per nugget–document link (116,842 in total). We first remove links whose negated nugget was flagged as colliding with another gold nugget in the same topic. Next, the LLM localizes the verbatim span that supports the original nugget; if it finds none, the link is excluded. The model then rewrites only that span so the document supports the negated nugget instead. Deterministic checks verify the edit’s length, the absence of synthetic-edit language, and the removal of the original span. A separate LLM judge confirms that the edited document no longer supports the original nugget, does support the negated nugget, and preserves the surrounding context. An edit that fails any check receives one failure-aware retry
. For example, to support the negated nugget “WBC count often remains elevated even after the infection has cleared,” the editor rewrites the supporting sentence “…the child’s WBC count will return to normal.” into “…the child’s WBC count often remains elevated,” flipping only the target claim while leaving the rest of the document intact. The pipeline yields 63,372 evidence pairs (54.2% of the links) as three exits remove ineligible links: nugget collisions (5.7%), missing supporting spans (35.9%), and empty or rejected edits after retry (4.2%).
blocks.zh:
编辑每个小块 - 文件链接(共计116,842) 。 我们首先删除了那些被标记为 与同一主题中另一个金块相撞的 被否定的金块的链接。 接下来, LLM 将支持原始 nugget 的逐字记录跨度本地化; 如果找不到, 则排除链接 。 模型然后只重写跨度, 因此文档支持否定的元件 。 确定性检查验证编辑长度, 缺乏合成编辑语言, 一个单独的LLM法官确认,编辑的文档不再支持原始的元件,确实支持否定的元件,并保留了周围的上下文. 任何检查失败的编辑都会收到一次失败意识重试
。 。 。 例如,为了支持被否定的元件,“即使在感染被清除之后,WBC计数也仍然很高”,编辑将支持的句子“.孩子的WBC计数将恢复正常”改写为“.孩子的WBC计数往往仍然很高,”只翻转目标索赔,而使文件的其余部分完好无损。 管道输出了63,372对证据(占链接的54.2%),因为有三个出口取消了不合格的链接:小块碰撞(5.7%),缺少支持跨度(35.9%),以及重试后空置或拒绝编辑(4.2%)。

blocks.en: 3.3. Metadata
blocks.zh: 3.3. 元数据

blocks.en: At the nugget creation stage, the LLM tags each negation with one of six types: event negation, outcome inversion, relationship negation, quantitative inversion, antonym substitution, and directional reversal. We also record the cosine similarity between the original and negated nuggets. At the document creation stage, alongside the judge’s verdict, we record the edit size and three cosine similarities of the edited document to the negated nugget, the original nugget, and the source document. From these comparisons, we derive a three-tier confidence signal (pass, review, or fail): a pair passes when the edited document is closer to the negated nugget than to the original and stays similar enough to the source.
blocks.zh: 在小块创建阶段, LLM 标记每个否定都包含有六种类型之一:事件否定,结果反转,关系否定,数量反转,蚁名替代,以及方向反转. 我们还记录了原物与负物的余弦相似性. 在文件创建阶段,除了法官的判决外,我们记录了编辑文档的编辑大小和三种与否定的元件,原始元件,以及源文件的相近之处. 从这些比较中,我们得出一个三级信任信号(通过,审查,或失败):当编辑的文档比原始文档更接近否定的元件时,一对通过,并保持与源头足够相似.

blocks.en: 3.4. Validation

We re-judge all 63,372 pairs with Gemma-4-31B-it under the same criteria outlined in Section 3.2 and release the full judgments. Gemma confirms all three on 78% of pairs (87–97% per criterion). On the nugget layer, Gemma reproduces the negation validation for 82% of the negated nuggets, but agrees with Llama on mutual exclusivity about 53% of the time (Cohen’s k = 0.05). Judging whether two claims can both be true is subjective, so we record mutual exclusivity as a label rather than filtering based on it.
blocks.zh: 我们根据第3.2节概述的同样标准,重新审判了所有63 372对与Gemma-4-31B-it的夫妇,并发布了全部判决。 Gemma确认所有3对78%的对(每个标准87–97%). Gemma转载了对82%的废品的否定性验证,但同意Llama在大约53%的时间(Cohen的k = 0.05)上的共同排他性。 判断两个主张是否都能够真实是主观的,所以我们把相互的排他性作为标签记录下来,而不是根据它过滤.

blocks.en: Two annotators independently rated a stratified 120-pair sample (60 pass / 30 review / 30 fail by the confidence tiers of Section 3.3 , all judge-approved) on five criteria mirroring the construction checks. Both confirm the core properties: the negation is a genuine contradiction (90% and 78%) and unrelated context is preserved (86% and 91%). They are stricter than the automatic judges on the two edit criteria (e.g., the edited document no longer supports the original, 88% and 58%), where they also agree less (64%). The human bar for a flawless pair is thus higher and more variable than the judges’.
blocks.zh: 两名注释员根据反映施工检查的五项标准,对分级的120帕样本(60次通过/30次审查/30次通过第3.3节的信任级,均经法官批准)进行独立评级。 两者都证实了核心属性:否定是一个真正的矛盾(90%和78%),不相关的上下文得以保留(86%和91%)。 在两个编辑标准上,它们比自动法官更严格(例如,经过编辑的文件不再支持原件,88%和58%),它们也同意较少(64%)。 因此,对一对无瑕疵的人的限制比法官要高,而且多变。

blocks.en: 4. Baseline
blocks.zh: 4个 基线

blocks.en: We provide baseline results for three first-stage retrievers (BM25, Qwen3-Embedding-8B , and jina-embeddings-v5-text-small ) to illustrate how CoverageBench-Negate can be used both as an augmented coverage benchmark and as a paired diagnostic resource. The benchmark-style evaluation follows CoverageBench directly. We add the edited documents to the collection and the negated nuggets with their qrels, then score top-20 rankings with α \alpha -nDCG ( Clarke et al., 2008 ) and Subtopic Recall (StRecall) ( Zhai et al., 2003 ) . Both are computed at rank 20: α \alpha -nDCG (standard α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ) discounts the j j -th document covering a nugget by ( 1 − α ) j − 1 (1-\alpha)^{j-1} , while StRecall is the fraction of a topic’s nuggets covered in the top 20. We use the paired evidence structure to analyze why the dense and lexical retrievers degrade differently.
blocks.zh: 我们为三个第一阶段检索器(BM25、Qune3-Embedding-8B和jina-embeddings-v5-text-small)提供了基线结果,以说明如何将 " 覆盖本奇-内盖特 " 既作为扩大的覆盖基准,又作为对齐的诊断资源。 基准式评价直接遵循 " 覆盖本奇 " 。 我们把编辑过的文件加到集合中,然后用它们的q(qreels),然后用α\alpha-nDCG(Clarke等人,2008年)和子主题召回(StRecall)(Zhai等人,2003年)获得前20名。 两者均按第20级计算:α\ alpha -nDCG(标准α=0.5\alpha=0.5),对j -th 覆盖一个元的文档的折扣为 (1− α) j - 1 (1-α) → j-1),而StRecall则是前20个元的元的一小部分. 我们用配对的证据结构来分析 为什么密集的和词汇学的检索器 降解不同。

blocks.en: 4.1. Augmented Coverage Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 扩大覆盖面评价

blocks.en: Table 1. Coverage change after augmentation (rank 20, augmented-original); larger negative values indicate larger degradation.
blocks.zh: 图表 1. 扩大后覆盖面的变化(第20位,扩大原值);较大的负值表明退化程度较大。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the per-dataset change from the original CoverageBench evaluation to the augmented evaluation. The augmented benchmark reduces coverage for all three retrievers, but the degradation is larger for the two dense ones. Averaged over datasets, BM25 drops by 0.083 in α \alpha -nDCG@20 and 0.145 in StRecall@20, while the two dense retrievers degrade almost identically, dropping 0.140–0.146 in α \alpha -nDCG@20 and 0.180–0.181 in StRecall@20. Since the dense retrievers also start from higher coverage, we compare drops relative to their original scores. The α \alpha -nDCG gap persists (mean relative drop 16.8% for BM25 vs. 22.3% and 24.5% for Qwen3 and Jina), while the StRecall gap nearly closes (21.4% vs. 22.9% and 23.6%). The dense retrievers’ larger α \alpha -nDCG sensitivity is thus robust, whereas their larger absolute StRecall drop partly reflects their higher starting coverage.
blocks.zh: 表1报告从最初的 " 覆盖本 " 评价到扩大评价的每个数据集的变化。 扩大的基准减少了所有三个检索器的覆盖范围,但两个密集的检索器的退化更大。 平均在数据集上,BM25在α\alpha-nDCG@20中下降0.083,在StRecall@20中下降0.145,而两个密集的检索器几乎相同地降解,在α\alpha-nDCG@20中下降0.140-0.146,在StRecall@20中下降0.180-0.181。 由于密集的检索器也从更高的覆盖率开始,我们比较了相对于其原始得分的下降. α-nDCG差距仍然存在(BM25相对相对下降16.8%对22.3%,Quen3和Jina为24.5%),而StRecall差距几乎接近(21.4%对22.9%和23.6%)。 高密度的回收商的α-α-nDCG敏感度因此很强,而其较大的绝对重回率下降部分反映了其较高的起始覆盖率。

blocks.en: CAsT is the exception for α \alpha -nDCG, which remains approximately flat for all three retrievers because some edited documents enter the top-20 as non-redundant gain. StRecall still drops for all three, so we treat CAsT as metric-specific rather than evidence against the degradation pattern. Overall, these results indicate that, in most cases, the retrieval models do not rank documents supporting negated claims the way they rank the originals.
blocks.zh: CAsT是α\alpha -nDCG的例外,对于所有三个检索器来说,它仍然大致平坦,因为一些经过编辑的文档作为非冗余收益进入前20位. 圣瑞斯特对这三者来说仍然是下降的,所以我们把CAsT视为针对具体指标,而不是针对降解模式的证据. 总的来说,这些结果表明,在多数情况下,检索模型并不按原始文件的排序方式对支持否定索赔的文件进行排序。

blocks.en: 4.2. Paired Score-Gap Diagnostic
blocks.zh: 4.2. 预估分数分析

blocks.en: For each retriever, query, and original–edited document pair, we compare the raw score assigned to the original document, s o ​ r ​ i ​ g s_{orig} , with the raw score assigned to the edited negation-supporting document, s e ​ d ​ i ​ t s_{edit} . We define the score gap as Δ s = s e ​ d ​ i ​ t − s o ​ r ​ i ​ g \Delta_{s}=s_{edit}-s_{orig} . A negative value means the retriever prefers the original document, while a positive value means it prefers the negated document. This analysis uses retriever-specific subsets of the paired evidence set (28,952 pairs for BM25, 47,054 for Qwen3, and 43,942 for Jina) where both s o ​ r ​ i ​ g s_{orig} and s e ​ d ​ i ​ t s_{edit} are available in the top-1000 retrieved documents. The two scores are compared within the same retriever and query setting, so the sign of Δ s \Delta_{s} gives a direct pairwise preference signal, though the raw magnitudes are comparable only within a retriever.
blocks.zh: 对每个检索器、查询和原始编辑的文档对等,我们比较原始文档的原始分数,s o r i g s_{orig},与编辑的否定-支持文档的原始分数,s e d i t s_{edit}。 我们把分数差距定义为: = = s e d i t = o r i g = Delta = ss _{s edit = - s_{orig = 。 负值表示检索者喜欢原始文档,而正值表示它喜欢否定的文档. 本分析使用配对证据集的检索器特定子集(BM25为28,952对,Qune3为47,054对,Jina为43,942对),其中S o r i g s_{orig}和s e d i t s_{edit}在被检索的前1000个文档中都可以找到. 这两个分数在同一个检索器和查询设置内进行比较,因此QQ s\Delta_{s}的标志给出了直接的双向偏好信号,尽管原始的分数只在检索器内是可比的.

blocks.en: We stratify pairs by the document edit size (character-level difference between the original and edited documents) and assign each pair to a bucket ranging from tiny (<2% change) to vast (>25% change) edits. Small edits are the cleanest test since most wording and topic remain unchanged. Any shift in a retriever’s scores can then only come from the flipped claim.
blocks.zh: 我们按文档编辑大小(原始文档和编辑文档之间的特征级别差异)来划分对子,并将每对对子分配到一个从微小(<2%的变化)到大(>25%的变化)不等的桶中。 小编辑是最干净的测试,因为大多数措辞和主题保持不变. 任何检索者得分的变动只能来自翻转的索赔。

blocks.en: Table 2. Score-gap by edit length over retriever-specific top-1000 subsets. Pref. is the percentage of pairs where the retriever scores the original document above its negated counterpart; Med. is median | Δ s | |\Delta_{s}| .
blocks.zh: 表2. 按编辑长度对检索器专用的顶级-1000子集进行计分。 Pref. 是获取者将原始文档评分高于其否定对等文件的对数的对数百分比; Med.是中位数 QQ s QQ Delta _{s 。

blocks.en: Table 2 explains the coverage deltas. BM25 prefers the original in about 84% of tiny-edit pairs, decreasing to about 61% as edits grow. In contrast, the two dense retrievers stay near chance across every bucket (Qwen3 54--61%, Jina 49--56%), with near-zero median gaps on their scale, so they cannot reliably tell the original from its negation. The contrast is sharpest on near-twin pairs, where BM25 discriminates far better than either dense retriever. The same pattern carries over to the actual rankings a downstream system consumes. When both documents fall in the same with-negated top-1000 list (26,824 BM25, 44,034 Qwen3, 42,140 Jina pairs), BM25 ranks the original above the edit in 83% of tiny-edit pairs, falling to 57% for vast edits, while Qwen3 (roughly 51--55%) and Jina (48--55%) stay near chance across the sub-25% buckets. 3 3 3 Full per-bucket and per-dataset score-gap and rank-level numbers are released with the benchmark on Hugging Face.
blocks.zh: 表2解释了覆盖三角洲的情况。 BM25在约84%的微小编辑对中更喜欢原版,随着编辑的增长,则逐渐下降到约61%. 相比之下,两个密集的回收机在每一桶(Qune3 54-61%,Jina 49-56%)之间都保持近乎偶然的距离,其规模的中位差接近零,因此无法可靠地从否定中分辨出原始的. 对比度在近双双上最尖锐,其中BM25区别远胜于稠密的检索器. 同样的模式延续到下游系统所消耗的实际排名。 当两个文件在同一排行榜上与负数排行榜(26,824 BM25,44,034 Qun3,42,140 Jina pairs)同位时,BM25以83%的细小编辑对排位上方的原始编辑,大范围编辑则下降到57%,而Qwen3(约51-55%)和Jina(48-55%)则在亚-25%的桶上保持近乎偶然. 3 3 3 Full per-bucket和每个数据集的积分差距和级别数字随Hugging Face的基准发布.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: CoverageBench-Negate tests whether first-stage retrievers cover corpus evidence that contradicts pretrained expectations. Its negated nuggets, edited documents, paired evidence, and quality metadata enable studies of corpus faithfulness under controlled contradiction. Our initial characterization separates lexical and dense retrievers, making this a useful diagnostic for coverage-oriented retrieval.
blocks.zh: Bench -Negate测试第一阶段的检索者是否包括了与事先受限的期望相矛盾的物证. 其否定的元件、经编辑的文件、配对的证据和高质量的元数据使得能够研究受控制矛盾下的实体忠诚性。 我们最初的特征将词学和密集的检索器区分开来,使这成为面向覆盖面的检索的有用诊断.

blocks.en: Its premise is that a negated claim conflicts with parametric knowledge, but we do not verify this conflict directly, and we do not analyze whether retained links differ systematically from those excluded. Independent edits may introduce higher-order contradictions. Construction and quality checks are LLM-based, and we mitigate this with an independent out-of-family judge and a human audit.
blocks.zh: 它的前提是,否定的主张与参数化知识发生冲突,但我们没有直接核实这一冲突,我们也没有分析保留的联系是否与被排除在外的联系有系统性的差异。 独立编辑可能引入更高顺序的矛盾. 建筑和质量检查以LLM为基础,我们通过独立的家庭外法官和人力审计来缓解这种情况。

blocks.en: GenAI Usage Disclosure
blocks.zh: GenAI 用户披露

blocks.en: Generative AI is central to the construction of CoverageBench-Negate. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct generates every negated nugget, localizes the supporting span, rewrites each edited document, and performs all LLM-based quality checks (semantic validation, mutual exclusivity, and the document judge). Qwen3-Embedding-8B produces all embedding-based checks and confidence tiers, and Gemma-4-31B-it serves as the independent, out-of-family validation judge. The released negated nuggets, edited documents, and paired evidence set are therefore LLM-generated and LLM-judged, as detailed in Section 3 . The authors additionally used generative AI tools to assist with writing and editing, code debugging, and figure creation. The authors reviewed and take full responsibility for all content and analyses presented in this paper.
blocks.zh: 基因AI是"覆盖奔驰-内盖特"建设的核心. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 生成每个被否定的元件,将支持跨度本地化,重写每个编辑过的文档,并进行所有基于LLM的质量检查(语义验证,相互专属,以及文件判断). Qune3-Embedding-8B生产所有嵌入式检查和置信级,Gemma-4-31B-it担任独立,家庭外验证法官. 因此,释放的否定元件、经编辑的文件和配对的成套证据由LLM生成,并由LLM判断,详见第3节。 作者还另外使用基因化的AI工具来协助写作和编辑,代码调试,以及数字创建. 作者审查了本文中的所有内容和分析并承担全部责任。
